page: City page: B2B lead generation Sydney (/b2b-lead-generation-sydney)

items.question: Does Myntmore have an office in Sydney?
items.answer: No. Myntmore's only office is in BKC, Mumbai, and every engagement runs remotely. Companies selling to Sydney work with us over calls, a shared dashboard and a weekly report, the same way our other clients do. This page describes the Sydney market we reach, not a local branch.

items.question: Who is lead generation for Sydney built for?
items.answer: B2B companies that want meetings with Sydney buyers, mainly financial services, SaaS and professional services firms. That includes firms based there and Indian or international companies selling into Australia. If your buyers are businesses, not consumers, the same system adapts to your ICP.

items.question: We are an Indian company that wants clients in Sydney. Can you help?
items.answer: Yes. We build separate sending domains so your main domain is never at risk, write copy for buyers in Sydney and send in their working hours. Sydney is 4.5 hours ahead of India in the Australian winter and 5.5 hours in summer, so meetings fit the Indian morning. Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff.

items.question: Is cold email allowed for Sydney buyers?
items.answer: Australia's Spam Act 2003 requires consent for commercial email, which can be inferred when a business address is conspicuously published and the message relates to the person's role. Every email needs sender details and a working unsubscribe. This is general information, not legal advice.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.
